(āḥ)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus su mchod pha

tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus su mchod phreng rgyas par bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa bsod nams rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī ye/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus su spros pa la dga' bas mchod phreng rgyas par bya ba'i tshul ni/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa bzang shing rgya che ba bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ tshogs zhing khyad par ba spyan 'dren pa yan chad rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam bzhin bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis rlabs la thal mo sbyar te/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi nī sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du tshig thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ lha rdzas zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams// zhes dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ me tog ji snyed dang*/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos ji snyed dang*/ dhūṣ+pe/ snang gsal ji snyed dang*/ ā lo ke/ dri mchog ji snyed/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas ji snyed/ nai wi d+ye/ rol mo ji snyed yod pa rnams dang*// shab+da gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi'i sngags rol chen rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas phul/

gos zung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha yi gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi// na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /sngar gyi mtshan sngags kyi mjug tu waṣ+ṭa ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes gos zung phul/ de nas snying ga nas rig ma bcu drug spros te/ dam pa rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ ma// ston ka'i mdog mtshungs pi waṃ lag /pi waṃ sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra wi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'di 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ rdo rje lha mo gling bu ma// gser gyi mdog can gling bu lag /gling bu'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi// badz+ra waṃ se= rdo rje lha mo rnga zlum ma// ban+dhu'i mdog can rnga zlum lag /rnga zlum= /nam mkha'= /badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge= rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga ma// margad mdog can rdza rnga'i lag /rdza rnga'i= /nam mkha'= /murdza= rdo rje lha mo bzhad pa mo// keng shu'i mdog mtshungs bzhad pa'i zhal// 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha'= /badz+ra ha s+ya= rdo rje lha mo sgeg pa mo// dbang sngon mdog mtshungs sgeg pa'i tshul// snyem pa'i lus dang dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha'= /badz+ra la s+ye= rdo rje lha mo glu dbyangs ma// 'char kha'i mdog mtshungs glu len ma// snyan pa'i glu dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha'= /badz+ra girti= rdo rje lha mo gar mkhan ma// margad mdog mtshungs gar bsgyur zhing*// gar dang ldan pa'i dbyangs ldan ma// nam mkha'= /badz+ra nirti= rdo rje lha mo me tog ma// gur gum mdog mtshungs me tog lag /me tog char dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha'=

/badz+ra puṣ+pe= rdo rje lha mo bdug spos ma// du ba'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos lag /bdug pa'i sprin dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha'= /badz+ra dhup+pe= rdo rje lha mo mar me ma// glog 'od mdog mtshungs mar me'i lag /mar me'i 'od dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha'= /badz+ra dī pe= rdo rje lha mo dri chab ma// pri yang mdog mtshungs du ba'i lag /dri yi char dang rol mor bcas// nam mkha'= /badz+ra gan+dhe= rdo rje lha mo me long ma// chu shel mdog mtshungs me long lag /sna tshogs gzugs kyis mnyes byed ma// nam mkha'= /badz+ra rū pa badz+ra= rdo rje lha mo zhal zas ma// dza ba'i mdog mtshungs zhal zas lag /zhal zas bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pa// nam mkha'= /badz+ra ra sa badz+ra= rdo rje lha mo na bza' ma// margad mdog mtshungs na bza'i lag /gos dang reg bya 'khyud par ldan// nam mkha'= /spar+she badz+ra= rdo rje lha mo chos dbyings ma// kun+da'i mdog mtshungs chos 'byung lag /zag pa med pa'i bde ster ma// nam mkha'= /dharmā dha tu= zhes mchod/ de nas rgyal srid bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga sogs kun rig ltar mtshan sngags sbyar nas mchod pa ni phyi mchod/ nang gi mchod pa ni oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin rlabs dran par byas la/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod 'thor zhing*/ oṃ mchod do// phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub pa'i dbang po rdo rje dril bu par// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung ḍā+eṃ gi pa// don dam mchog brnyes grub chen an+tar pa// brtson pas grub pa mnyes pa'i tai lo pa// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

paṇa grub 'khor los sgyur ba'i nā ro pa// snyan brgyud slob bshad 'dzin pa'i pham thing pa// zab lam mthar phyin klog skya shes rab brtsegs// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skad gnyis smra ba lo chen blo gros grags// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bla chen sa skya pa// de sras thu bo rje btsun sku mched gnyis// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan 'phags pa rin po che// chos brgyad 'ching ba kun spangs dkon mchog dpal// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtse gcig sgrub pa mthar byin brag phug pa// 'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// bshad sgrub chu bo kun 'dus dpal ldan par// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan zhabs// rgyal bas lung bstan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// 'khor lo sdom pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/chos kyi rgyal po blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs// grub pa mchog gi ded dpon rdo ring pa// bstan pa'i srog shing tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nges par thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// khyab bdag bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan dpal// rigs kyi bdag po rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snyan brgyud mnga' bdag mkhan chen zhwa lu pa// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bud+dha rat+na'i zhabs// sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab ting 'dzin bzang*// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga'i mtshan// 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs// rigs kun khyab bdag maṅga'i mtshan can la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang*// ngur smrig gar gyis dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen// mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma gsum gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras// snyan brgyud gdams pa kun gyi bka' babs pa// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang smin byed dbang dang grol byed lam// zab mo'i lam gyi man ngag ston mdzad pa// dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' khyab chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// bdag gi yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bya ba'i rgyud ces sogs nas skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig gi bar dkyil chog ltar brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes myangs pas gsung rdo rje myos par bsam pa ni nang mchod do// de nas yid byung gi mchod pa ni/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya/ ā brta ya hoḥ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ dha tu a ka sha sa man+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri shud+dha ya/ maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pra ṇi te/ puṇ+ya dzñā na ba len sarba ta thā ga ta ba man+ta ban+dha ba le nā tsa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing se gol gdab/ de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rol chen bya zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wa ra hi bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya a pa ra dzi t+ye trai lok+ṣa mahā bid+ya shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhu ta bha ya h+ye mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ na mo badz+ra a pa ni dze te a pa ra dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo shwa ṣa ni ro ṣa ni kro dha ka ra li hūm̐/ oṃ na maḥpra sa ni ma ra ni pra bhe da ne a pa rā dza ye swā hā/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ye bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+wam bha ni hūm̐/ oṃ na maḥbadz+ra wa ra hi mahā yo gi nī ka ma shwa ri kha ge hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs sh+lau ka gnyis brjod/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dang ba'i yid kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi// 'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// chags can skyes bu 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir// brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med// rgyun mi chad pa'i bde ba'i ros gang ma// mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus kyang*// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma// mkha' spyod snying rjes yongs gang la phyag 'tshal// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rjes gzhan gyi dbang gyur nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs ma// mkha' spyod 'gog pa med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bzhi don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spangs brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bden gnyis rnam dag rim gnyis dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgom pa// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes sh+lau ka re'i mtshams su dril bu gsil zhing bstod par bya'o// de nas bum bskyed sogs dkyil chog bzhin no// rdo rje btsun mo'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod phreng rgyas par bya ba'i tshul// 'dren mchog bla ma'i gsung bzhin du// tshes bcu la sogs rgyas pa'i dus// 'di ltar rnam pa gsal mthong nas// mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nyams len gyi// lhan thabs tshul du bkod pa 'di// shākya'i btsun pa lhun grub gyis// gzhan don tshul du bkod pa dge/

༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug cho ga'i zur 'debs bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub cing mchod pa'i skabs kyi nye bar mkho ba'i zur 'debs tho tsam bkod na/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga gzhir bzhag nas/ sbyor ba'i skabs su bsham sogs phal cher dkyus ltar las gtor ma gnyis sam/ gtor chog rgyas pa dang 'brel na lnga tshar bsham/ dngos gzhi la thog mar dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod nas/ mchod g.yog pas sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab kyis bran te/ phyag gsum btsal la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma la bsang sbyangs gnang nas 'bul bar zhu zhes dang*/ dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas bskor zhing phaiṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥsogs kyis spyan drangs la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing nang mchod srin lag gis gtor la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sa'i phyogs 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/

srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ deng nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung zhing dngos grub sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod/ ces dang*/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba de dag sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces dang*/ oṃ sum+bha sogs drag sngags brjod cing rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol/ mchod g.yog pas gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ de nas mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu zhes bskul/ dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la oṃ sum+bha ni sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ so so'i sngags rgya sogs dkyus bzhin las/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs lan gsum brjod pa'i dang pos mchod yul spyan drangs/ gnyis pas mchod yul de rnams kyis bdag dang gnas khang byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas mchod rdzas la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de nas slob dpon du 'os pa dang tshogs pa grangs mang bar bzhugs na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad rnams kye rdor dbang chu ltar grub pa dang*/

bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyi skyabs sems dkyus ltar dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ma rgyud spyi ltar byas la/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs nas bdag bskyed rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blangs pa'i mthar nā da yang mi dmigs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur ces pa'i rjes su/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur zhes brjod do// mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nang mchod dang mañdzi steng gi gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gnyis ka la dmigs te byin rlabs rgyas par bya ba ni/ oṃ sum+bhas bsang*/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ de rnams re re'i steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang chub kyi sems/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ lhor am̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin gyi oṃ yig dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po mgo bo thur du lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams bskol bas 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/

oṃ dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ mdun gyi thod pa la thod pa thim/ bdud rtsi la bdud rtsi thim/ oṃ dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mdun gyi nang mchod nas rdo rje'i rtses dkyil 'khor gsum char la gtor la/ sum+bha sogs kyis bsang*/ swā bhā was sbyangs pa nas stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung sogs nas tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i sogs nas gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya'o// mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin rlabs bsdus pa dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar byas la 'dir gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi mi dgos so// de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par mos la/ de'i steng gi char brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*/ mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa tsam gyis sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar bzhugs par bsams la/ de rnams la mchod pa'i bsam pas so so'i phyag rgya dang gdangs snyan pas/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na// lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+rā yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du tshig rkang gnyis pa dang mchod pa'i sngags bsgyur ba dang bcas te/

shab+da'i bar dang gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ gos zung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ya āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa ni/ oṃ wī ṇi badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ zhes so so'i sngags brjod pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod lha mo pi waṃ ma la sogs brgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs bsnams pa/ so so'i kha dog dang mchod rdzas thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'jig rten gyi khams gang bar spros te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchod par bsams la/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi waṃ ma// sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma// nam mkha' gang ba sems kyis rab sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs pi waṃ sgra yis mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra bī ṇi badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi ti āḥ zhes brjod la mchod par bsam/ de bzhin du tshig rkang gnyis pa gsum pa dang*/ sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ oṃ waṃ se badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ gser bzang mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gling bu'i sgra yis mchod/ waṃ se= oṃ mṛ taṃ ga badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rdza rnga ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod/ mṛ taṃ ga= oṃ murdzi badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnga zlum sgra yis mchod/ murdzi= oṃ ha s+ye badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa mo// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod/

ha s+ya= oṃ lā s+ya badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg mo ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod/ lā s+ya= oṃ gī ti badz+ri ni hūm̐ āḥ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs snyan pa'i glu yis mchod/ gī ti= oṃ mṛ t+ye badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ pri yang ku mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod/ nṛ t+ye= oṃ puṣ+pe badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs me tog sil mas mchod/ puṣ+pe= oṃ dhū paṃ badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ in+d+ra nī la'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdug spos sprin gyis mchod/ dhū paṃ= oṃ dī paṃ badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mar me'i phreng bas mchod/ dī paṃ= oṃ gan+dhaṃ badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ sin+dhu'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dri bzang byug pas mchod/ gan+dhaṃ= oṃ rū pa badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gzugs kyi bde bas mchod/ rū pa= /oṃ ra sa badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ btsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ro yi bde bas mchod// ra sa= oṃ spar+ṣe badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs reg bya'i bde bas mchod// spar+ṣe= oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos khams bde bas mchod// dharma dhā tu= de nas rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// zhes tshigs bcad dang mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i tsakra rat+na sogs nas spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar phyi mchod dang*/

nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod srin lag gis sor mos spyi gtsug nas 'thor zhing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs nas mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa ltar rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin gyi mtshan nas brjod la 'bul/ de'i rjes su brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la nang mchod dbul ba ni/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje chos// mkha' spyod dbang mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub pa'i sar bzhugs paṇa chen nā ro pa// pham thing sku mched zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// zab yangs chos kyi gter gyur shes rab brtsegs// gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mal lo'i zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dngos bla chen sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gnas lnga rig pa sa skya paṇa chen dang*// 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i zhabs// rim gnyis thugs gzhol dkon mchog dpal ba dang*// brag phug chos rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// 'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// gdams pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan pa// shar chen ye rgyal ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun dga' dbang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// rgyal ba gnyis pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po seṅge'i mtshan// sa bcu'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas rin chen dang*// lha mchog seṅge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// shes bya kun mkhyen dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i dbang po seṅge'i mtshan// mthu stobs dbang phyug dkon mchog dpal ldan dang*// brang ti paṇa chen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// mkhyen rab dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis zhabs// grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan don grub dang*// thugs rje'i gter chen nam mkha' sangs rgyas zhabs// shes rab 'byung gnas zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bud+dha'i mtshan// sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin shes bya bzang po sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang dbang bskur sogs nas lan gsum brjod zhes pa'i bar bdag 'jug ltar dang*/

de nas yid mchod ni dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas nas/ na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs nas/ ba la na tsā le swā hā/ zhes se gol lan gnyis gdab pa ni yid byung gi mchod pa'o zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bstod pa ni spro na yum gyi rkang brgyad dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs dang*/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin sogs yan lag bdun ldan gyi bstod pas bstod la/ gzhan yang thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ mkha' spyod lam rim dang mthun pa'i smon lam yang 'don no// dkyus su gtor ma 'dir phul bar gsungs kyang bdag 'jug gi rjes su 'bul na bde bar 'dug pas de bzhin mdzad/ de nas bum pa nang rdzas kyis gang ba sogs nas bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur ces brjod do// zhes pa'i bar gyis bum bzlas grub nas/ de nas rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal sogs nas deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// de nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma mdzes rgyan bzhin phul ba'i mthar rjes chog nas brtsams te dga' ba gsum dang ma bral bar bya'o zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar byas la/ de nas spro na/ lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ bye brag nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol 'debs smon lam byas te/ rdor dril gsor dkrol dang me tog 'thor bzhin pas phun tshogs dge legs sogs byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa'i bkra shis sogs gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang shes brjod do// zhes pa 'di ni paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i cho ga'i mi gsal ba rnams kyi gsal byed tho chung 'di ni bya bral maṅga las bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/
slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
